title: Scroll button
description: A button or link that scrolls the page to an element, the top or the bottom.

scrollTo.description: Where to scroll: a CSS selector, `top` or `bottom`. `target` is accepted as well; a link with neither uses its href.

behavior.visualReason: How the page moves on click; the button at rest looks the same.

offset.description: Pixels to stop above the target, for a fixed header.
offset.visualReason: Changes only where a click scrolls to.

label.description: The button's text when it has none of its own.

_metadata.derivedFrom: src/wb-viewmodels/helpers.js — every property here is one the behavior reads
